MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 33
   D. 32

2. Solve for x: x + 8 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 9
   C. 17
   D. 10

3. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 3

5. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 144

6. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 73
   C. 17
   D. 72

7. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3

   C. 41
   D. 13

8. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 36

10. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 1
   C. 57
   D. 56

11. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 12
   C. 13
   D. 7

12. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 24

13. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 33
   D. 4

14. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 36

15. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 26
   C. 13
   D. 170

16. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 10

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
